extra_train_provenance.license: GPL-3.0 repository-wide as published; image-specific terms not separately documented

calibration_report.scope: Source-domain image evaluation of frozen global-softmax thresholds; not field diagnosis validation
calibration_report.interval_limitations: Wilson intervals are descriptive. Image dependence, incomplete physical-leaf grouping, historical selection exposure and CAL threshold search are not covered by binomial intervals.

plantvillage.scope: Source-domain image evaluation of frozen global-softmax thresholds; not field diagnosis validation
plantvillage.interval_limitations: Wilson intervals are descriptive. Image dependence, incomplete physical-leaf grouping, historical selection exposure and CAL threshold search are not covered by binomial intervals.

plantdoc_field_like.scope: Source-domain image evaluation of frozen global-softmax thresholds; not field diagnosis validation
plantdoc_field_like.interval_limitations: Wilson intervals are descriptive. Image dependence, incomplete physical-leaf grouping, historical selection exposure and CAL threshold search are not covered by binomial intervals.

field_protocol.similarity_rule: Original-training images only; union exact SHA-256 or 64-bit dHash distance <=4, transitive closure; conservative grouping without duplicate identity claims.
field_protocol.assignment_method: Deterministic greedy minimum normalized squared deviation from per-class and total 70/15/15 targets; all groups stay in one partition.
field_protocol.label_status: Candidate mappings and source labels remain unreviewed by an agricultural expert. Limited image review checked quality/filename consistency only.
field_protocol.release_policy: Freeze this receipt before optional domain adaptation. Train only on train.jsonl; select checkpoint on tune.jsonl; reserve calibration.jsonl for the final fixed model/policy. external_test_locked.jsonl is final external evaluation only. Do not combine with PlantVillage tests as one field-accuracy claim.
